answer: How do you catch a forger who never works? You audit at random. A VRF beacon draws 5% of identities each epoch. Each drawn identity has 2 epochs to submit proof of real work to 7 jurors. Miss the deadline and rewards freeze for 6 epochs. Miss twice and half the stake is slashed. The whisper of the draw cannot be predicted, so hoarders cannot hide idle clones. The umber shadow is the 5% chance that never sleeps. Forging 1,000 identities locks 120,000 units, losing about 6,000 units per round. The audit is random, the cost is certain, and crystal proof is the only way out.
